name: South Pacific Current
scope: Declared 103 W to 88 W eastern regional studied reach between two reported Subtropical Front crossings associated with the SPC in the source regional surface circulation. Front locations are proxies, not diagnosed velocity-core endpoints, and were observed in different years. OSW connecting vertices and alternatives are editorial. Branch correspondence is unresolved. Excludes Chatham Rise/western basin, ACC export branch, Peru-Chile coastal flow, northward recirculation and independent split bands. Not a whole-current or simultaneous observed axis.
layer: Surface drifter circulation context combined with separate hydrographic STF crossing locations. The 14 C at 150 m frontal criterion does not define a 150 m current axis; drifter velocities include ageostrophic flow. No fixed-depth velocity centerline reconstructed.
time_convention: 1979–2004 regional drifter mean is context; P18 frontal crossing was sampled February–April 1994 and P19 February–April 1993. This editorial connection does not combine them into one dated trajectory or infer seasonal geometry.
source_locator: Chaigneau and Pizarro (2005), Data [4]–[5], surface circulation [7], STF [14]–[17] and Table 1: P18 at 103 W 33.8 S and P19 at 88 W 34.5 S. Source front/velocity distinction retained; fields and curves not digitized.
source_citation: Chaigneau and Pizarro (2005), Surface circulation and fronts of the South Pacific Ocean, east of 120 W, Geophysical Research Letters 32, L08605, doi:10.1029/2004GL022070.
source_license: AGU article copyright 2005. Source facts paraphrased and reported frontal crossings attributed; no source figure, curve or field copied.
coordinate_selection: Source reports two frontal crossing coordinates, observed in separate years. OSW connects them with intermediate vertices at 100 W 34 S, 96 W 34.2 S and 92 W 34.4 S. Latitude bends and endpoint offsets test drawing choices, not a measured current axis or uncertainty on the source observations.

alternative_routes.interpretation: Editorial connecting bend; not a seasonal phase or separate northern branch.
Editorial connecting bend; not an ACC or southern-branch axis.

scenario_rule: Three declared shapes crossed with fixed section longitudes and independent endpoint-latitude offsets -0.25/0/+0.25 degrees: 27 editorial cases. These test route drawing choices, not observation errors, current width or seasonal variation.
remaining_gates: Diagnose a same-layer velocity axis; frontal proxy locations are not current-core locations.
Recover compatible simultaneous observations before a dated route or seasonal extrema.
Resolve two-band correspondence within the 115–85 W split region described by Stramma et al. (1995).
Test front-to-flow correspondence against the layered supergyre distinction in Ridgway and Dunn (2007).
Resolve western and eastern continuation independently before a whole-current length or annual width.

supporting_sources.supports: SPC distinction from ACC, broad Chatham Rise context and possible splitting at 115–85 W. Does not assign a branch to this connection.
